description: This file defines the TransferManager class, responsible for managing file transfer operations in a sharing feature of an Android app. It enqueues transfer tasks, simulates transfer progress updates, and exposes transfer statuses via LiveData.

classes.name: TransferManager
classes.description: A singleton class that handles queuing, simulating, and tracking file transfer statuses in an Android application.

methods.name: enqueueShare
methods.description: Enqueues a new file sharing operation, assigning it an ID, initializing its status, and starting a simulated transfer process.

methods.name: simulateTransfer
methods.description: Simulates the transfer progress for a file, updating status periodically until completion.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Posts the current list of transfer statuses to LiveData for observers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the TransferManager instance, ensuring only one exists.
